nodes.summary: For every integer $n > 0$, the number of conjugacy classes of the holomorph $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z} \rtimes (\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^\times$ of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ equals $\varphi(n) \sum_{d \mid n} 1/\varphi(d)$, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function.
nodes.title: Class number of the holomorph of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$

nodes.summary: For a group $G$, let $\operatorname{Conj}(G)$ be the conjugation quandle on $G$, with $x \triangleleft y = x y x^{-1}$. Then $G$ has trivial center if and only if the permutations of $G$ that are group automorphisms are exactly the rack automorphisms of $\operatorname{Conj}(G)$.
nodes.title: Trivial center and automorphisms of the conjugation quandle

nodes.summary: Let $n > 0$, let $A = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$, and write $(a, u)$ for the element of the holomorph $A \rtimes A^\times$ with $a \in A$ and $u \in A^\times$. Two elements $(a, u)$ and $(b, v)$ are conjugate if and only if $u = v$ and there is a unit $y \in A^\times$ with $b \equiv y a$ modulo the ideal $(1 - u)A$ generated by $1 - u$.
nodes.title: Conjugacy in the holomorph of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, let $A = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ and write $(a, u)$ for the element of the holomorph $A \rtimes A^\times$ with $a \in A$ and $u \in A^\times$. For all $a, b \in A$ and $u, v \in A^\times$, $(a, u)(b, v) = (a + u b, u v)$.
nodes.title: Multiplication in the holomorph of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, let $A = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$. The holomorph of $A$ is the semidirect product $A \rtimes A^\times$ in which the unit group $A^\times$ acts on $A$ by multiplication. Its elements are the pairs $(a, u)$ with $a \in A$ and $u \in A^\times$, with product $(a, u)(b, v) = (a + u b, u v)$.
nodes.title: Holomorph of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, every $a \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ and every unit $u \in (\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^\times$, the affine map $T_{a,u} \colon x \mapsto a + u x$ is a rack automorphism of the dihedral quandle $R_n$, the set $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ with $x \triangleleft y = 2x - y$.
nodes.title: Affine maps are automorphisms of the dihedral quandle

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, an element $a \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ and a unit $u \in (\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^\times$, $T_{a,u}$ is the affine map $x \mapsto a + u x$ of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$, viewed as a permutation of the dihedral quandle $R_n$ (the set $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ with $x \triangleleft y = 2x - y$).
nodes.title: Affine permutations of the dihedral quandle

nodes.summary: Let $n > 0$, let $R_n$ be the dihedral quandle on $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ (with $x \triangleleft y = 2x - y$), and for $a \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ and $u \in (\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^\times$ let $T_{a,u}$ be the permutation $x \mapsto a + u x$ of $R_n$. For all $a, b \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ and $u, v \in (\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^\times$, the virtual racks $(R_n, T_{a,u})$ and $(R_n, T_{b,v})$ are isomorphic…
nodes.title: Isomorphism of affine virtual dihedral quandles

nodes.summary: For a rack $R$ with operation $\triangleleft$, the automorphism group $\operatorname{Aut} R$ is the subgroup of the group of permutations of $R$ consisting of the permutations $f$ with $f(x \triangleleft y) = f(x) \triangleleft f(y)$ for all $x, y \in R$.
nodes.title: Automorphism group of a rack

nodes.summary: For every $n > 0$, the number $v(R_n)$ of isomorphism classes of virtual racks whose underlying rack is the dihedral quandle $R_n$ (the set $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ with $x \triangleleft y = 2x - y$) equals $\varphi(n) \sum_{d \mid n} 1/\varphi(d)$, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function.
nodes.title: Virtual quandle structures on the dihedral quandle

nodes.summary: For a rack $R$, let $\operatorname{Aut} R$ be its group of rack automorphisms; a virtual structure on $R$ is an element $f \in \operatorname{Aut} R$, and $(R, f)$ is the corresponding virtual rack. The number $v(R)$ is the number of classes of virtual structures on $R$, where $f, g \in \operatorname{Aut} R$ are identified when the virtual racks $(R, f)$ and $(R, g)$ are isomorphic; that is, the number of…
nodes.title: Number of isomorphism classes of virtual racks on a rack

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a rack and let $f_1$ and $f_2$ be elements of its automorphism group $\operatorname{Aut} R$. Then the virtual racks $(R, f_1)$ and $(R, f_2)$ are isomorphic if and only if $f_1$ and $f_2$ are conjugate in $\operatorname{Aut} R$.
nodes.title: Isomorphism of virtual structures is conjugacy

nodes.summary: For every rack $R$ and every permutation $f$ of $R$, the pair $(R, f)$ is isomorphic to itself in the sense of virtual rack isomorphism. The permutation $f$ need not be a rack automorphism.
nodes.title: Reflexivity of virtual rack isomorphism

nodes.summary: Write $x \triangleleft y$ for the operation of a rack. A virtual rack $(R, f)$ is a rack $R$ together with a rack automorphism $f$ of $R$, its virtual structure. Let $R_1$ and $R_2$ be racks and let $f_1$ and $f_2$ be permutations of $R_1$ and $R_2$. Then $(R_1, f_1)$ and $(R_2, f_2)$ are isomorphic when there is a bijection $\psi \colon R_1 \to R_2$ such that…
nodes.title: Isomorphism of virtual racks

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the group homomorphism from the unit group $(\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^\times$ to the automorphism group of the additive group $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ that sends a unit $u$ to multiplication by $u$, the automorphism $x \mapsto u x$.
nodes.title: Multiplication action of the units of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
